instruction: Compare iPhone 14 Pro Max with iPhone 14 Pro using Apple's comparison page

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing two iPhone 14 Pro models (Max vs regular). Agent needs to navigate to Apple Compare page and select iPhone 14 Pro Max and iPhone 14 Pro. The evaluator parses the URL query parameter 'modelList' and verifies it contains the two specified models in any order.
metadata.verification: Similar task to original - comparing 2 iPhone Pro models from same generation (Max vs regular). Uses identical evaluator structure with different model names.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree and parses the modelList query parameter
Metric comparison logic properly validates both iPhone models are present in the comparison using ignore_list_order flag
Expected values are semantically correct - 'iphone-14-pro-max' and 'iphone-14-pro' match Apple's model identifiers
Complete coverage - evaluator verifies user navigated to comparison page with both specific models
No postconfig needed - URL state is persistent and accessible after task completion
Data flow is correct: URL extraction -> query parameter parsing -> list splitting -> exact model name comparison
